manualReview.result: manual review failed; stop patching custom block interactions
notes: Task20f implemented more browser-observed repairs and passed automated checks, but manual review still reported the same user-facing failures.
Code block language/copy/wrap controls remain insufficiently discoverable or usable for real users despite custom jixiaCodeBlock controls.
Image/file/attachment cards still feel inert in manual review; custom card click and hidden-input activation remain a fragile BlockNote/contentEditable integration.
Paste/drop still fails in realistic use; the current shell/card handlers only handle File-like DataTransfer payloads and do not use BlockNote native file insertion.

The correct next step is to stop adding patches to jixiaImage/jixiaFile/AttachmentBlock event plumbing and build a BlockNote-native file pipeline using uploadFile, resolveFileUrl, file panel, and native file insertion semantics.
